# 3.3 VECTOR MOVING-AVERAGE MODELS

When p = 0, the model in Eq. (3.1) reduces to

```
z_t = c_0 + θ(B)a_t, (3.55)
```

which is a vector moving-average (VMA) model of order q. The VMA models can occur in many situations. For example, temporal smoothing of independent
